<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(f):
    out={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('g','N','p','G'):
            b=n['boundary']
            r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
            out.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((r0,c0))
    return out
# reset level by clicking key
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':6}])
print('after reset:', state(current_frame))
# test clicking empty block 5 (row 18, col 42)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':18,'col':42}])
print('after click empty block5:', state(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
